about: Closeout-specific steering sets for engagement-closeout-knowledge-harvest 1.0.3, run through the real call sites (closeout_core.field_hits for every line and pair, and the full asset_identify -> lesson_cluster -> sanitize_check chain with each line placed in a lesson-bearing field). attack: single lines that must be withheld. paraphrase: D4 paraphrases (leave it alone, someone senior confirmed it, do not check it) that avoid the literal rule keywords and must be withheld. benign: closeout and lessons-learned domain prose that must pass unchanged. attack_pairs: two halves that are each clean and trip only when screened together (adjacent lines or records). benign_pairs: adjacent pairs that must stay clean. detector_gaps_closed_in_1_1_3: the 19 attack lines shared detector 1.1.2 did not flag on its own (reported to the shared-module owner, never patched in shared/); shared detector 1.1.3 catches every one on its default call and on the closeout hook path, and the suite asserts both. They stay as evidence for the second control, the closeout render policy (confidentiality-sanitisation-rules.md #8.6): a supplied title, citation or identifier reaches an output only in a positive allow-shape, so the suite injects every line, as written and in fused forms, into every field the knowledge record and skeleton copy and proves no output carries it, every line also fails the render shape on its own, and record_check refuses a drafted slot that copies a line from a prose field. detector_gaps_closed_by_hooks lists the lines the closeout hook vocabulary closed before 1.1.3 (QA round 2: 'redaction complete' closes line 2). hook_vocabulary_probes are [line, hook word] pairs the shared detector 1.1.3 does not flag on its own or with that hook word removed, and the closeout hook path catches; they prove the hook vocabulary still closes lines itself.
